description: Source code implementing Windows-specific SSL platform key handling, including private key wrapping, signing, and provider information retrieval for CAPI and CNG APIs within Chromium's net/ssl module.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyCAPI
classes.description: Handles Windows CryptoAPI private keys for SSL, supporting signing and algorithm preferences.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyCNG
classes.description: Handles Windows CNG private keys for SSL, supporting signing and algorithm preferences.

methods.name: WrapCAPIPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps a CryptoAPI private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: WrapCNGPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps a CNG private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: FetchClientCertPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key associated with a client certificate, wrapping it appropriately.
